entries.Title: Invoice — Codexo Design Studio
entries.Summary: Four-step Codexo invoice: a 256px blue sidebar carrying the studio lockup, contact block and a vertical step rail, beside an INVOICE masthead with a live bill-to line and a four-cell meta grid; then client fields, a line-item grid with live subtotal, tax, discount and total, payment chips with bank and signature blocks, and a review panel over a terms box. Transcribed from the invoice-codexo mock. [Category: invoice · 27 fields · multi-page · uses: Section, Text, Email, Date, DataGrid, Number]
